rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: Short version: predict matches better than your friends, manage your chips well, and finish with the most chips in the room.
list: Everyone starts with 1,000 chips in a room.
You get 100 fresh chips each day when you come back.
Before kickoff, you can place one prediction per match.
A match prediction is one exact score, like 2-1 or 1-1.
Match odds are sourced from Polymarket.
Each match bet has two independent parts: a side pick (home, draw, or away) and an exact score pick.
You choose how many chips to stake on each part. Either stake can be 0, but the total must be at least 2 chips.
If your side pick is right, that side stake pays at the locked side odds. If your exact score is right, that score stake pays at the locked score odds.
Once kickoff happens, normal match betting closes.
You can propose custom bets during a match or create room-wide custom bets at any time before their lock time.
When a match or custom bet is settled, winners are paid in chips.
Highest chip count at the end wins. No real money involved.

friendsLanding.faqTitle: Questions people ask before they start

faq.question: Is Buckeclub a real-money betting app?
faq.answer: No. Buckeclub uses virtual chips for friendly competition with friends.

faq.question: What custom bets can we make with friends in the app?
faq.answer: You can run football props like first scorer and first yellow card, plus unrelated bets like who arrives last to the watch party.

faq.question: Where do the match odds come from?
faq.answer: For supported World Cup 2026 match markets, Buckeclub fetches the displayed odds from Polymarket.

faq.question: Do all my friends need accounts?
faq.answer: Yes. Each friend signs in and joins the same room so every bet and leaderboard move is tied to a real player.
